instruction: An intimate studio portrait photograph captured in a medium close-up shot at eye-level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white background, the dark-haired woman (R2) stands in the foreground wearing a beige blazer over a white top, holding a bouquet of yellow and white flowers in both hands while looking directly at the camera with a calm expression. Standing behind her, the redhead woman (R1) wears a light blue shirt and a pearl necklace, resting both hands on her friend's shoulders and leaning her head gently against her temple with her gaze directed downwards. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting, creating a gentle, warm color palette with a soft-focus background.
